_purpose: The declared-retirement list for R-INVARIANT-DELETION (PROJECT_CHARTER.html). A retirement is complete when the retired artifact is DELETED from source. 'Deprecated-but-present is not a state. Deprecated-but-still-called is a defect.' verify_r-invariant-deletion_declared_retirements.js greps the source files below for every name in this list and fails on ANY hit -- code, HTML attribute, or comment. A comment that names a retired artifact is a grep hit and is treated as one: reword it to describe the history without the identifier (e.g. 'the retired affirmation handlers', plus the ledger T-number).
_how_to_retire_something: 1. Add the name here IN THE SAME CHANGE that declares it retired. 2. The test is red until the artifact is gone from every source file listed in source_files. 3. An entry is never removed from this list: it stays as a permanent guard so the name cannot be reintroduced. 4. Do not use the word 'complete' for the migration in TIMELINE.md without citing the specific removal.

_retired_s_fields_note: S.* fields declared retired by name. The test also runs a residue detector that needs no declaration: any field initialised in S that has no reader anywhere is write-only (dead) state and fails. Declare a field here only to guard it against reintroduction after deletion.
_s_field_consumer_files_note: Files OUTSIDE qr.html that read S fields by name; the residue detector treats a field read only by one of these as NOT dead. Keep this list equal to the real set of consumers: a listed file that is absent from the repo is reported by the test and treated as reading nothing. OPEN ITEM (2026-09-30): test_harness/trace.js is listed because earlier analysis found it reading _isOtherTileEntry and adlibConfirmed, but it was not among the project files supplied later that day. If trace.js is gone from the repo, remove it here -- those two fields then have no reader and the detector will (correctly) call them dead. trace.js is the operator's read-only observation layer (deployed from the repo root: <script src=.../trace.js>); it reads nine S fields and writes none, so a field it reads is not dead. The path is the repo root, not test_harness/.
